title: Split queue CSS wrapper
summary: Split styles.queue.css into an import-only parent wrapper plus queue child stylesheets, and migrated direct queue CSS tests to resolve parent @import wrappers.
reason: Continue the CSS split implementation pack after the completed components and pages splits while preserving queue WebView visual behavior and wrapper import ownership.
behavior_before: styles.queue.css contained queue table, ordering, source/scope, File Override drawer, light-mode, and responsive CSS directly, while some tests asserted queue selectors by reading the parent CSS file text.
behavior_after: styles.queue.css is an import-only wrapper for queue child stylesheets under styles/queue, and direct queue CSS tests resolve wrapper imports before asserting selectors.
manual_validation: PASS: Phase 1 tests.webview.test_webview_dropdown_remediation_static -q after migrating direct queue CSS reads to resolved imports.
KNOWN FAIL: Phase 1 tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q retained pre-existing Reports JS split assertions.
KNOWN FAIL: Phase 1 tests.webview.test_webview_css_design_tokens -q retained pre-existing token/raw CSS and Reports JS split assertions.
KNOWN FAIL: Phase 3 tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q retained pre-existing Reports JS split assertions.
KNOWN FAIL: Phase 4 tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q and tests.webview.test_webview_css_design_tokens -q retained the known Reports/token/raw CSS baselines.
KNOWN FAIL: Phase 5 tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q retained pre-existing Reports JS split assertions.
PASS: Phase 6 tests.webview.test_webview_dropdown_remediation_static -q, tests.webview.test_webview_browser_queue_file_overrides_smoke -q, and npm run webview:check.

KNOWN FAIL: Phase 6 tests.webview.test_webview_css_design_tokens -q retained pre-existing token/raw CSS and Reports JS split assertions; failures track existing declarations now reported from child files.
PASS: Queue split exit-criteria script verified import-only wrapper, child import paths, no child parent imports, and pinned selectors through the recursive CSS import resolver.
KNOWN FAIL: Final tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q retained pre-existing Reports JS split assertions.
KNOWN FAIL: npm run webview:prework:check passed webview:check then failed at the pre-existing webview lint budget increases.
rollback_plan: Restore styles.queue.css from this change's pre-split version, remove the styles/queue child stylesheets created for this split, and revert the three test updates to direct parent-file reads.
notes:
Converted queue parent CSS toward an import wrapper while preserving rule order.
Moved queue priority badge, priority menu, priority toolbar, and row emphasis CSS into the queue priority child file.
Moved queue ordering strategy, manual-order toolbar, pagination, filter summary, and drag-state CSS into the queue ordering child file.
Added queue CSS import resolution coverage and used resolved queue CSS in design-token assertions.
Migrated queue CSS selector assertions to resolve the queue CSS import wrapper.
Moved queue table layout, loading state, row-state, selection, and settings-column CSS into the queue table child file.
Moved queue source inventory and scope/evidence presentation CSS into the queue scope child file.
Moved file override drawer trigger, overlay, drawer shell, footer, and status CSS into the file override shell child file.
Moved shared file override sections, labels, inherited-status controls, and input/select CSS into the file override form child file.
Moved file override route disclosure, route preview status, and encode advisory CSS into the route child file.
Moved file override source-info, detected track metadata, exact track action, loading, badge, and warning CSS into the tracks child file.
Moved file override series/remux pilot modal and batch preview CSS into the series child file.
Moved queue responsive and reduced-motion blocks into the final queue responsive child file.
Moved queue and File Override light-mode overrides into the final queue light-mode child file.
Refreshed generated summary for the queue CSS split implementation.
